meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 06.1 Motion Accessibility & Context QA

normal_motion.logo_reveal: PASS — 700–900ms acceptable only as non-blocking brand/application moment
normal_motion.map_camera: PASS_WITH_RULE — 280–480ms; only when orientation benefit is clear; must be interruptible
normal_motion.overlay_panel: PASS — 200–280ms with focus handoff independent of animation
normal_motion.then_now: PASS_WITH_RULE — motion supplements explicit state, never replaces it
normal_motion.connection_graph: PASS_WITH_RULE — animate relationship focus only; no perpetual graph movement

reduced_motion.map: PASS — jump/short fade; no camera fly

keyboard_focus.overlay_open: PASS_WITH_RULE — focus moves to meaningful first target or container after semantic state change, not after animation completes
keyboard_focus.map_marker: PASS — keyboard selection cannot depend on hover animation
keyboard_focus.story_navigation: PASS — chapter/scene focus state updates immediately

interruption.user_navigation: PASS_WITH_RULE — new input cancels/shortens prior transition immediately
interruption.map_camera: PASS_WITH_RULE — wheel/pan/keyboard/marker selection interrupts active camera animation
interruption.story_scene: PASS_WITH_RULE — next/previous navigation replaces in-flight transition cleanly
interruption.overlay: PASS — close action available throughout transition

timing_accessibility.autoplay: PASS_WITH_RULE — content-heavy surfaces default off; meaningful autoplay needs pause/control
timing_accessibility.loading: PASS — structural skeleton/progress preferred over decorative loops

production_corrections: Focus movement must be tied to semantic state change, never animation-end events.
All user-triggered map camera and scene transitions must be cancellable by fresh input.
Reduced-motion mode must disable camera fly, path drawing, parallax and large scale/translate, not merely shorten them.
Logo/hero cinematic motion may never gate navigation or essential content.
Then & Now and Journey progress must retain explicit textual/state cues even when all motion is removed.
Connection graphs may animate selected relationships only; continuous ambient node drift is prohibited on core content surfaces.
Autoplay ambient/cinematic motion is off by default on content-heavy surfaces; any meaningful autoplay requires pause/stop control.
Animation completion events must not be required for data loading, focus state, URL/navigation state, citations or evidence visibility.

decision.condition: include the eight implementation rules above in the locked baseline
